Definition: from G545; to disbelieve (wilfully and perversely):--not believe, disobedient, obey not, unbelieving.
BiblicalUsage: To disbelieve, to refuse to be persuaded — the one who believes not the Son shall not see life, the disobedient people God stretched out his hands to all day long, the generation that could not enter his rest because of unbelief, and the stone the builders rejected. Refusal, not ignorance, is the heart of it.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that unbelief is a decision, not a fog, and that makes the gospel's offer all the more urgent. God holds his hands out all day long, and I believe the only right answer is to take them.
